title: O*NET Work Styles to Big Five Personality Mapping
description: Maps O*NET Work Styles (1.C.x.x) to Big Five personality dimensions. Based on established psychometric research correlating O*NET occupational characteristics with the Five-Factor Model (FFM/OCEAN).
references: Costa, P.T. & McCrae, R.R. (1992). Revised NEO Personality Inventory (NEO-PI-R)
Barrick, M.R. & Mount, M.K. (1991). The Big Five Personality Dimensions and Job Performance
Judge, T.A. et al. (2002). Personality and Leadership: A Qualitative and Quantitative Review

OPENNESS.name: Openness to Experience
OPENNESS.description: Reflects imagination, creativity, curiosity, and willingness to explore new ideas

CONSCIENTIOUSNESS.name: Conscientiousness
CONSCIENTIOUSNESS.description: Reflects self-discipline, orderliness, dutifulness, and goal-directed behavior

EXTRAVERSION.name: Extraversion
EXTRAVERSION.description: Reflects sociability, assertiveness, positive emotionality, and energy

AGREEABLENESS.name: Agreeableness
AGREEABLENESS.description: Reflects cooperation, trust, empathy, and concern for others

EMOTIONAL_STABILITY.name: Emotional Stability (Low Neuroticism)
EMOTIONAL_STABILITY.description: Reflects calmness, emotional resilience, and ability to handle stress

1.C.1.a.description: Job requires establishing and maintaining personally challenging achievement goals and exerting effort toward mastering tasks
1.C.1.a.rationale: Achievement orientation is a core facet of Conscientiousness, with secondary links to Extraversion's activity/energy component

1.C.1.b.description: Job requires persistence in the face of obstacles
1.C.1.b.rationale: Persistence directly maps to Conscientiousness self-discipline; also requires emotional resilience

1.C.1.c.description: Job requires a willingness to take on responsibilities and challenges
1.C.1.c.rationale: Initiative reflects Extraversion's assertiveness and proactivity, with Conscientiousness driving goal pursuit

1.C.2.b.description: Job requires a willingness to lead, take charge, and offer opinions and direction
1.C.2.b.rationale: Leadership strongly correlates with Extraversion (assertiveness, dominance) and Conscientiousness (organization, reliability)

1.C.3.a.description: Job requires being pleasant with others on the job and displaying a good-natured, cooperative attitude
1.C.3.a.rationale: Cooperation is a defining characteristic of Agreeableness, with interpersonal warmth from Extraversion

1.C.3.b.description: Job requires being sensitive to others' needs and feelings and being understanding and helpful on the job
1.C.3.b.rationale: Empathy and concern for others are core Agreeableness facets (tender-mindedness, altruism)

1.C.3.c.description: Job requires preferring to work with others rather than alone, and being personally connected with others on the job
1.C.3.c.rationale: Social orientation directly reflects Extraversion's gregariousness and need for social interaction

1.C.4.a.description: Job requires maintaining composure, keeping emotions in check, controlling anger, and avoiding aggressive behavior
1.C.4.a.rationale: Self-control maps to Emotional Stability (low anger/hostility) and Agreeableness (non-aggression)

1.C.4.b.description: Job requires accepting criticism and dealing calmly and effectively with high-stress situations
1.C.4.b.rationale: Stress tolerance is the defining characteristic of Emotional Stability (low neuroticism)

1.C.4.c.description: Job requires being open to change (positive or negative) and to considerable variety in the workplace
1.C.4.c.rationale: Adaptability reflects Openness to new experiences and change, with Emotional Stability supporting flexibility under pressure

1.C.5.a.description: Job requires being reliable, responsible, and dependable, and fulfilling obligations
1.C.5.a.rationale: Dependability is a core expression of Conscientiousness - dutifulness and reliability

1.C.5.b.description: Job requires being careful about detail and thorough in completing work tasks
1.C.5.b.rationale: Attention to detail maps directly to Conscientiousness orderliness and thoroughness facets

1.C.5.c.description: Job requires being honest and ethical
1.C.5.c.rationale: Integrity involves Conscientiousness (following rules, duty) and Agreeableness (honesty, sincerity)

1.C.6.description: Job requires developing one's own ways of doing things, guiding oneself with little or no supervision, and depending on oneself to get things done
1.C.6.rationale: Independence reflects Openness (self-direction), Conscientiousness (self-discipline), and some Extraversion (assertiveness)

1.C.7.a.description: Job requires creativity and alternative thinking to develop new ideas for and answers to work-related problems
1.C.7.a.rationale: Innovation is the quintessential expression of Openness - creativity, imagination, and novel ideas

1.C.7.b.description: Job requires analyzing information and using logic to address work-related issues and problems
1.C.7.b.rationale: Analytical thinking maps to Openness (intellectual curiosity) and Conscientiousness (careful deliberation)

OPENNESS.description: Openness is primarily measured through Innovation, Adaptability, Analytical Thinking, and Independence

CONSCIENTIOUSNESS.description: Conscientiousness is primarily measured through Dependability, Persistence, Attention to Detail, Achievement/Effort, and Integrity

EXTRAVERSION.description: Extraversion is primarily measured through Social Orientation, Leadership, and Initiative

AGREEABLENESS.description: Agreeableness is primarily measured through Concern for Others and Cooperation

EMOTIONAL_STABILITY.description: Emotional Stability is primarily measured through Stress Tolerance and Self-Control

aggregationWeights.description: Weights for aggregating O*NET Work Styles scores into Big Five dimension scores. Uses weighted average based on correlation strength.

utilities.getElementsByBigFive: Filter mappings where primaryBigFive or secondaryBigFive matches the given dimension
utilities.calculateBigFiveScore: Sum of (elementScore * aggregationWeight) for each element in the dimension's aggregationWeights
utilities.getPrimaryMapping: Return the primaryBigFive dimension for a given O*NET element ID
